questions.question_text: Translate shape T by the vector (3, 4).
Reflect shape T in the line y = -x.
Rotate shape T by 90° anticlockwise about (-2, 1).
Describe fully the single transformation that maps shape T onto shape U.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps shape T onto shape V.
Show that Nikhil receives $350 and that Padma receives $280 when $630 is shared in the ratio 5 : 4.
In a sale, prices are reduced by 18%. Padma buys a jacket for $98.40 in this sale. Calculate the original price of the jacket.
Padma decides that she does not like the jacket and sells it for $30. Calculate the percentage loss made by Padma.
Calculate how much of the $280 Padma now has.
Padma invests $150 at a rate of 2% per year compound interest. Calculate the total value of this investment after 10 years. Give your answer correct to the nearest dollar.

On January 1st 2016, Nikhil invested all of his $350 at a rate of 0.15% per month compound interest. Find in which month and in which year Nikhil’s investment will first have a total value of at least $500.
Find the median from the cumulative frequency curve.
Find the inter-quartile range from the cumulative frequency curve.
Find the number of cars with an average speed of more than 70 km/h from the cumulative frequency curve.
A bus completes a journey in 2h 24 min at an average speed of 50 km/h. A car completes the same journey in 1h 45 min. Calculate the average speed of the car.
The cost of a drink of water is w cents. The cost of a drink of juice is (w + 30) cents. The total cost of 6 drinks of water and 5 drinks of juice is $4.14. Find the value of w.
The total area of the square of side x cm and the rectangle of sides (x + 3) cm and (x + 1) cm is 10 cm^2. Find the perimeter of the square, correct to 2 decimal places.
Show that triangles ADX and BCX are similar. Give a reason for each statement that you make.
AX = 5 cm, DX = 2 cm and CX = 3 cm. Calculate BX.
AD = 4.61 cm. Calculate angle AXD.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for 0 <= x <= 20, where f(x) = sin(x^2) and x^2 is in degrees.
One solution of the equation f(x) = 0, for 0 <= x <= 20 is x = 0. Find the other two solutions.
Find the co-ordinates of the local maximum point for f(x).
There is a local minimum point at (0, 0). Find the co-ordinates of the other local minimum point when 0 <= x <= 20.
Write down the range of f(x).
By sketching another graph on the diagram, solve the equation sin(x^2) = (x^2)/20 - 1.
The diagram shows a plastic solid made by joining a hemisphere of radius 5 cm to a cone of height 12 cm. Calculate the volume of the solid.
One cubic centimetre of the plastic has a mass of 0.95 g. Calculate the mass of the solid. Give your answer in kilograms.
Find the number of these solids that can be made from 1 tonne of plastic.
Calculate the total surface area of the solid.
A solid cone has radius r cm and height 3r cm. The total surface area of the cone is 377 cm^2. Find the value of r.
The equations of the asymptotes to the graph of y = x / ((x + 2)(x - 1)(x - 2)) are x = a, x = b, x = c and y = d. Find the values of a, b, c and d.
f(x) = k has only one solution, where k is an integer and k != 0. Find the value of k.
Find the integer value of x such that f(x) < 0.
Given g(x) = x^2 - p, on the diagram, sketch a possible graph of y = g(x) so that f(x) = g(x) has 5 solutions.
U = {students in a music group}, P = {students who play the piano}, G = {students who play the guitar}, n(U) = 23, n(P U G)' = 2, n(P \cap G') = 7, n(G \cap P') = 3. Find n(P \cap G).
A student is chosen at random from the music group. Find the probability that this student plays the piano but does not play the guitar.
Two students who play the guitar are chosen at random. Find the probability that they both also play the piano.
On the Venn diagram, shade the region P \cup G'.
Find h^(-1)(x).
Find g(h(x)) in its simplest factorised form.
Simplify f(x) / g(x).
In the diagram, ADC is a straight line, angle ABD is a right angle, BD = 8 cm, angle ADB = 34°, and BC = 19 cm. Calculate AB.
Calculate angle DBC.
Calculate the area of triangle ABC.
Find the nth term of the sequence: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, ...
Find the next term in the sequence: 2, 12, 36, 80, 150, 252, ...
Find the nth term of the sequence: 2, 12, 36, 80, 150, 252, ...
